aviso.sinAlmacen: This browser won't let us save your progress. You can still use the app, but it will be lost when you close it.
inicio.practica.desc: Three minigames picked for today, with what you need to review.
juego.merge-conflict.desc: Two versions of a sentence: accept the right one.
juego.caza-el-bug.desc: Find and fix the mistakes in a text.
juego.prompt.desc: Complete sentences by typing in a terminal.
juego.incidente.desc: Fix the server by reading logs and messages.
juego.ordenar-frases.desc: Put the words in the right order.
juego.ahorcado.desc: Guess the tech word letter by letter.
juego.dictado-codigo.desc: Type the code you hear read aloud.
juego.dilo-bien.desc: Pronounce terms people often get wrong.
juego.daily-standup.desc: Listen to your team and answer in the meeting.
juego.dictado-audio.desc: Listen to a sentence and type it.
juego.falsos-amigos.desc: Does it mean what it seems? Swipe and decide.
juego.acronimos.desc: What each acronym stands for and how to say it.
juego.sopa-crucigrama.desc: Find terms with clues in English.
juego.emparejar.desc: Match each word with its picture or definition.
juego.contrarreloj.desc: Get as many right as you can before time runs out.
juego.educado-o-borde.desc: Pick the message with the right tone.
juego.bug-report.desc: Order and complete a bug report.
bienvenida.idioma.titulo: Which language do you want the app in?
bienvenida.objetivo.titulo: How much do you want to practise each day?
bienvenida.objetivo.texto: You can change it any time in Settings.
bienvenida.nivel.texto: You'll start with exercises at your level and move up as you practise.
bienvenida.nivel.a1.desc: Ideal if you're just starting with English.
datos.texto: Your progress is only saved on this device. Export it now and then so you don't lose it or to move it to another one. On iPhone, install the app: Safari may delete data from websites you haven't opened for a week.
datos.importar.confirmar: All your progress and settings will be replaced with the ones in the file.
datos.importar.error: That file isn't valid Hello English progress. Nothing has been changed.
datos.borrar.confirmar: All your progress and settings will be deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
ajustes.voz.frase: Hello! Let's practise some English for developers.
voz.noDisponible: This browser can't read aloud. Listening exercises won't be available.
voz.sinIngles: This device has no English voice installed.
voz.sinAcento.gb: This device has no British voice: another English voice will be used.
voz.sinAcento.us: This device has no American voice: another English voice will be used.
ajustes.vibracion.no: This device or browser can't vibrate.
ejercicio.errorCarga: The exercises couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
juego.salir.texto: You keep the points you've already earned.
fa.instruccion: Does the English word mean this? Swipe the card or choose.
mc.instruccion: There's a conflict: keep the version that's written correctly.
juego.necesitaVoz: This minigame needs the browser to read aloud, and this one can't. Try Chrome, Edge or Safari.
juego.repasos.uno: You have 1 exercise to review: it will come up in this game.
juego.repasos.varios: You have {n} exercises to review: they will come up in your games.
practica.texto: Three minigames picked for today: first the one with the most to review, then the ones you have played least. Tomorrow there will be others.
practica.completada.texto: Well done! You can keep playing whatever you like from the home screen.
logro.perfecta.desc: Finish a game without a single mistake.
logro.diez-perfectas.desc: Finish 10 games without a single mistake.
logro.racha-3.desc: Meet your goal 3 days in a row.
logro.racha-7.desc: Meet your goal 7 days in a row.
logro.racha-30.desc: Meet your goal 30 days in a row.
logro.explorador.desc: Play a minigame from every category.
logro.repaso-10.desc: Master 10 exercises you had got wrong.
logro.repaso-50.desc: Master 50 exercises you had got wrong.
cb.instruccion: One word is wrong. Tap it to fix it.
pr.instruccion: Type the missing word and press Enter. Tab (or Hint) gives you a letter.
in.final.bien.texto: You made all {total} right calls: the service came back quickly and nobody noticed.
in.final.regular.texto: You got {n} of {total} calls right: you fixed it, but some users noticed.
in.final.mal.texto: You got {n} of {total} calls right: the service was down for a while. Time to write the post-mortem.
of.instruccion: Tap the words in order to build the sentence. Tap a placed word to send it back.
ah.instruccion: Guess the word from its definition. You can miss 6 times.
dc.instruccion: Listen to the line of code and type it. Spaces don't matter.
db.instruccion: How do you pronounce this word?
db.privacidad: Speech recognition is done by your browser; in Chrome, the audio is sent to Google's servers.
db.error.nada: I didn't hear anything. Try again.
db.error.permiso: There is no permission to use the microphone: you can choose the answer instead.
db.error.no-disponible: This browser can't recognise speech: you can choose the answer instead.
ee.noCoincide: That doesn't match any answer. Try again or tap one.
da.instruccion: Listen to the sentence and type it.
ac.instruccion: What does this acronym stand for?
sc.elige: How do you want to play?
sc.sopa.desc: Find the words hidden in the grid.
sc.crucigrama.desc: Type each word from its clue.
sc.sopa.instruccion: Tap the first and last letter of each word. The clues are in English.
sc.crucigrama.instruccion: Choose a clue and type the word. You get 2 tries per word.
sc.noEsa: Not that one. You have one try left.
em.instruccion: Tap a word and then what it means.
em.tableroHecho: Board complete. The ones marked ✗ you got wrong before getting them right.
cr.instruccion: What does it mean? Choose fast: 1/2 or ←/→.
br.instruccion: Tap each text to put it in the next field of the report. Tap a field to clear it.
br.bien: {n} of {total} fields right. This is the report:
ranking.inicio.lector: Today's leaderboard: position {pos}. Open the leaderboard
ranking.intro: Compete with other players on a daily and a monthly leaderboard. It's optional: if you don't join, the app works just the same.
ranking.queSeEnvia: When you join, only your nickname, the points you earn, your level, your streak and your daily challenge result are sent to the leaderboard server. Nothing else: no email, no account, no cookies.
ranking.aliasReglas: {min} to {max} characters: letters without accents, numbers, _ and -.
ranking.alias.corto: It must have at least {min} characters.
ranking.alias.largo: It can have at most {max} characters.
ranking.alias.caracteres: Use only letters without accents, numbers, _ and -, with at least one letter.
ranking.aliasFijo: You can't change your nickname later.
ranking.codigo.ayuda: The one the app gave you when you joined (HE-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX).
ranking.codigo.aviso: Keep this code safe: it lets you recover your nickname on another device or if you delete your data. Don't share it: anyone with it can play as you.
ranking.copiar.error: Couldn't copy it. Write it down.
ranking.recuperar.intro: Enter your recovery code to use your nickname on this device.
ranking.recuperado: You're back on the leaderboard as {alias}.
ranking.volverUnirse: I don't have a code: choose a nickname
ranking.vacio.dia: Nobody has scored today yet. Play a game and be the first!
ranking.vacio.mes: Nobody has scored this month yet.
ranking.sinPuntos.dia: You don't have any points today yet. Play a game to get in.
ranking.sinPuntos.mes: You don't have any points this month yet.
ranking.noDisponible: The leaderboard isn't available in this version.
ranking.salir.confirmar: The nickname {alias} and its leaderboard points will be deleted from the server. Your points and progress on this device won't change.
ranking.error.sin-red: You're offline. Try again when you have internet.
ranking.error.alias-usado: Someone else already has that nickname. Try another one.
ranking.error.alias-no-valido: That nickname isn't valid. Check the rules.
ranking.error.vetado: That nickname isn't allowed. Choose another one.
ranking.error.codigo: That code doesn't exist. Check it's typed correctly.
ranking.error.tope: Too many attempts. Try again later.
ranking.error.sin-servidor: The leaderboard isn't available in this version.
ranking.error.servidor: The leaderboard isn't responding right now. Try again later.
logro.medalla.desc: Finish a day in the top 3 of the leaderboard.
logro.oro.desc: Finish a day in 1st place on the leaderboard.
logro.top10-mes.desc: Finish a month in the top 10 of the leaderboard.
logro.campeon-mes.desc: Finish a month in 1st place on the leaderboard.
logro.reto-perfecto.desc: Get all 10 exercises of a daily challenge right.
aviso.resultado.dia: Yesterday you finished #{pos} of {n} on the leaderboard.
aviso.resultado.mes: Last month you finished #{pos} of {n} on the leaderboard.
ranking.viendo.liga: Only {nivel} players. Medals are based on the overall leaderboard.
ranking.sinPuntos.mesAnterior: You didn't score points last month.
ranking.rachas.explica: Days in a row meeting the daily goal. Only live streaks count (goal met today or yesterday).
ranking.vacio.rachas: Nobody has an active streak yet.
ranking.sinRacha: You don't have an active streak. Meet today's goal to get in.
ranking.vacio.reto: Nobody has played today's challenge yet. Be the first!
ranking.sinReto: You haven't played today's challenge yet.
ranking.error.sin-version: The leaderboard server doesn't have this feature yet. It needs updating (servidor/LEEME.md).
reto.pendiente: To do · only your first attempt counts
reto.antes: {n} exercises from A1 to C1, the same for everyone. Only your first attempt counts: if you leave halfway, what you have so far is saved. The most correct answers wins and, in a tie, the fastest.
reto.reglas: The most correct answers wins; in a tie, the fastest. Only the first attempt counts.
reto.yaHecho: You've already played today's challenge. There'll be a new one tomorrow.
reto.unete: Join the leaderboard to compare your result with everyone else's.
reto.salir.texto: Only the first attempt counts: if you leave now, today's challenge is saved with what you have so far.
recordatorio.texto: We'll remind you at the time you choose if you haven't met your goal that day, even when the app is closed.
recordatorio.activado: Done: we'll remind you at {hora} on days you haven't met your goal.
recordatorio.error.permiso: No permission to send notifications. You can allow them for this site in your browser settings.
recordatorio.no: This browser can't receive notifications from a website.
recordatorio.instalar: On iPhone and iPad, reminders only work with the app installed: tap Share → “Add to Home Screen” and open it from there.
recordatorio.sin-servidor: Reminders aren't available in this version.
recordatorio.privacidad: To remind you, the server stores your browser's notification address, the time, your time zone and your language. You don't need to be on the leaderboard. Turning it off deletes them.
recordatorio.notificacion.texto: You haven't met today's goal yet. A few minutes of English?
stats.flojos.texto: The mini-games where you make the most mistakes. Today's practice includes the first one.
stats.flojos.vacio: Nothing yet. Once you have {n} answers in a mini-game, you'll see here the ones you find hardest.
stats.vacio: Play a game to see your statistics.
stats.desde: Correct answers by mini-game and topic are counted from version 1.2.0.
